subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this browser copilot as a bundled extension surface once the remaining scoped-subscription isolation defect is repaired and upgrade behavior is explicitly accepted?
rationale: This is a large new core browser/Gateway capability with persisted pairing changes and a security boundary; code review can identify the defect but cannot decide the permanent product and upgrade contract.

options.title: Sponsor after isolation repair
options.body: Land the feature only after the broad subscription path is denied for scoped clients and final-head runtime proof covers the repaired security boundary.

options.title: Pause the bundled feature
options.body: Defer the side-panel product direction until maintainers choose a narrower long-term ownership and upgrade model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after isolation repair
recommendation.body: Land the feature only after the broad subscription path is denied for scoped clients and final-head runtime proof covers the repaired security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR identifies this contributor’s prior side-panel design as the basis for the intended product direction.
